# MCAP C++ (header-only) — vendored

- Upstream: <https://github.com/foxglove/mcap> (`cpp/mcap`)
- Version: 2.1.3
- Commit: `3fbb0542becbcba1b203efe0e80debebf0d28f02`
- License: see `LICENSE` (MIT)
- Local notes: header-only (single TU via `MCAP_IMPLEMENTATION`); compression
  (zstd/lz4) disabled via `MCAP_COMPRESSION_NO_ZSTD` / `MCAP_COMPRESSION_NO_LZ4`
  in the example's CMakeLists.txt.
